title: 第13章 不会用脑子一辈子都是坐骑第14章 责任重大使命光荣
slug: 西游平账大圣在我贪亿点咋了
content_zh:
苏元正对着斩仙飞刀一脸严肃的嘀嘀咕咕。
“别拜了！”
一个浑厚的声音在他身后响起，带着几分不耐。
“它只是个葫芦，又不是传讯玉符，听不见你嘀咕。”
苏元猛地回头，
只见那头鼻直口阔的墨麒麟不知何时已悄无声息地站在了他身后。
墨麒麟大袖一挥，周遭景象瞬间模糊，下一瞬二人又回到密室之中。
苏元忙不迭地从怀中掏出一壶下界的烈酒，殷勤地为其斟满。
墨麒麟喉头明显滚动了一下，却强行别开目光。
“我可不吃你这套，小子。
咱俩只是单纯的生意关系，别想着用酒来收买我。
有事说事，痛快点儿！”
苏元见状，也不勉强，自己将那杯酒一口灌下，
又换了个杯子斟满美酒。
烈酒如同一条火线从喉咙直冲而下，苏元脸色也变得愈发愁苦，
他重重叹了口气，演技全开，声音低沉。
“尊者，不瞒您说，我今天是来退钱的。”
墨麒麟眼皮抬了抬，鼻孔冒出一声疑惑。
“嗯？”
苏元一副破罐子破摔的模样，

“妈的，我认栽了，这生意做不了了。”
“是我苏元没本事，耽误尊者大事了。
这样，我不仅原数退还定金，再多退您一千万灵石，权当是给尊者赔礼道歉了。”
说着就要去掏储物袋。
墨麒麟顿时被勾起了好奇心，抬手按住苏元：
“等等！
先别急着退钱。
说说，怎么回事？前天不还信誓旦旦说万无一失么？你不是挺有能耐的么？”
苏元一脸苦笑，将自己如何找到下界的门路，如何准备报考招抚组，又如何被人凭借关系挤掉的故事讲了一遍。
墨麒麟听闻苏元居然真的有路子能够合法下界，
再结合苏元给他描述的宏伟走私蓝图，眼睛瞪得溜圆，连忙追问道。
“谁把你挤下去的？快跟我说！
我来给你做主！”
苏元假意含糊，语焉不详。
“只是听说姓窦，好像家里也是封神上来的，具体的信息，我就不知道了。”
墨麒麟听完，沉吟了一会，竟哈哈大笑起来。
content_en:
Su Yuan was muttering seriously to the Immortal Killing Flying Knife.
"Stop worshiping!"
A deep voice sounded behind him, with a hint of impatience.
"It's just a gourd, not a messenger talisman. I can't hear you muttering."
Su Yuan turned around suddenly,
Mo Qilin, who had a straight nose and a broad mouth, was standing behind him quietly at some point.
Mo Qilin waved his sleeve, and the surrounding scene blurred for an instant, and the next moment the two of them were back in the secret room.
Su Yuan hurriedly took out a pot of spirits from the lower realm from his arms and filled it diligently.
Mo Qilin's throat visibly rolled, but he forcibly looked away.
"I'm not going to do this to you, kid.
We just have a purely business relationship, don't try to buy me off with wine.
If you have something to say, be happy! "
When Su Yuan saw this, he didn't force himself and drank the glass of wine in one gulp.
He changed another cup and filled it with wine.
The strong alcohol rushed down from his throat like a line of fire, and Su Yuan's face became more and more sad.
He sighed heavily, his acting skills in full swing and his voice low.
"Sir, to be honest with you, I am here to refund the money today."
Mo Qilin raised his eyelids, and a sound of doubt came out of his nostrils.
"Huh?"
Su Yuan looked like he had broken a jar.
"Damn it, I admit defeat, this business can't be done anymore."
“It’s because I, Su Yuan, am incompetent and have delayed His Majesty’s important event.
In this way, I will not only refund the original deposit, but also refund you an additional 10 million spiritual stones. This can be regarded as an apology to His Holiness. "
As he said that, he went to take out the storage bag.
Mo Qilin's curiosity was suddenly aroused, and he raised his hand to hold Su Yuan down:
"Wait!
Don’t be in a hurry to refund your money yet.
Tell me, what's going on? Didn’t you promise the day before yesterday that everything would be perfect? Aren't you quite capable? "
Su Yuan smiled bitterly and told the story of how he found the way to the lower world, how he prepared to apply for the recruitment team, and how he was squeezed out by others because of his connections.
Mo Qilin heard that Su Yuan actually had a way to go down to the lower realm legally.
Combined with the grand smuggling blueprint that Su Yuan described to him, his eyes widened and he asked quickly.
"Who pushed you down? Tell me!
I'll make the decision for you! "
Su Yuan pretended to be vague and unclear.
"I just heard that his surname is Dou, and it seems that his family is also a god. I don't know the specific information."
After Mo Qilin listened, he pondered for a while and then burst into laughter.
